lines.en: Because it surely shan’t help you no matter what it was, but that alone doesn’t put an end to my curiosity.
You see, it rains every day where I come from. But that’s simply a side effect of losing someone you love.
I never have to worry about my plants getting thirsty. I never have to worry about my balcony getting covered in dust. But I do have to worry about floating away from time to time.
Just like you do now.
Can you feel it? The tide closing in? The way fish feel against your calves as broken shells dig deep into the wounds you earned when you walked on glass?
I hope you can.
Because you are the reason it rains every day here.
You are the reason I am wounded.
But I will never stop loving you because-
Well...
You’ll find out one day.
Anyway, here’s Io. It’s relevant.
: You don’t have to sit here with me all night, Uta. Go be social and...have fun with people or whatever it is you do. I’m fine.
: Like heck you’re fine. You haven’t been fine in weeks. In fact, you’ve gotten even worse since the Dorm Wars and you’re gonna have to tell me why eventually.
: Can you not just chalk it up to me being an unlovable meat-sack this time? That’s always worked in the past.
: Maybe for you. But you’re the most lovable meat-sack to me.
: I’m confused. Was that supposed to be a compliment?
: It sounded better in my head, okay? I’m just trying to remind you that you can-
: Talk to you whenever I want. I know. You’ve told me that probably fifty times today alone.
: Yet you haven’t even tried! I can tell when something’s wrong, Io. I’ve known you for years.
: Well, look at it this way — if something was really wrong, would I have bothered coming here at all?
: Yes! That’s exactly when you would bother coming here because you’d think something like, “If I don’t come, Uta will think something is wrong and I don’t want her to think that.”
: So you wouldn’t think anything was wrong if I actually stayed at home?
: No, I’d think something is wrong then too because your thought process would be, “Uta wants me to come but I am so beaten up that I don’t even have the energy to humor her right now.”
: Wow. I sound just as exhausting in your head as I do in mine.
: You are!
: In fact, you’re so exhausting that it makes me wanna blow my frickin’ brains out with my crossbow! And that’s not even a guaranteed instant kill! I’ve seen it happen! It’s gross!
: I thought you weren’t allowed to kill deer in Nara?
: We're not, but that’s never stopped my brother. I’m not even talkin’ about that though. My uncle’s a matagi. He hunts bears in Akita.
: With a crossbow?
: He says it “softens them up” but that’s beside the point, Io! I’m tired of you hiding things from me when all it does is make it impossible to cheer you up! Let me help you!
: I’d love to, Uta. Except, here’s the thing — we both have stuff about our past that we quite literally found out we can’t help each other with. That’s why we’re friends. Remember?
: Of course I remember! But-
: We’re done here. If you want to have girl-talk, there are like fifty other girls in the rooms down the hall you can go hang out with.
: She didn’t, like...show up again...did she?...
: I thought you said she was still outside of Kumon-mi? I thought-
: I’d have asked for your help burying a body by now if that’s what happened, Uta.
: But...why would you bring up the things we can’t help each other with if that’s not what’s going on here? I don’t get it. Why do you make it always so hard to understand what’s wrong?
: It’s just better off that way.
: Sometimes...the less you know, the better.
: Life’s messy enough as is. The last thing either one of us needs is one more thing to cry about. Mostly you, though. Crying is exhausting and makes my head hurt.
: So something did happen and you’re just purposely choosing to keep me in the dark.
: Yeah. That’s right.
: Don’t smile at me, Io. Do you have any idea how mad that makes me?

: Do you have any idea how mad you’d be if I told you the truth? Because it’s way worse. So just let me feel like shit for a little longer and you’ll get to keep your entire world-view intact. Sound good?
: Horrible, actually. It makes me feel like you have zero faith in me when I would trust you with my life.
: Trusting me with anything more than tools is just an accident waiting to happen, so I implore you to reconsider.
: I mean, yeah. You’re making that pretty obvious right now. But, at the same time, you’re kind of blowing things way out of proportion.
: How am I the one blowing things out of proportion when all I’ve done over the last couple weeks is try to get ahold of you?
: Repeat that last sentence, just a little slower.
: Okay. So I’m clingy. Yeah. But I’ve always been clingy. And you-
: And I’ve always been a scared and confused piece of shit.
: But, like...
: It’s been mostly just “confused” lately. That’s why I’ve been so absent.
: Like yeah, a thing happened. I had to confront some stuff I hate confronting. But for the first time in my life, it didn’t end in complete and utter tragedy.
: Maybe I’m just having a hard time figuring out what that means and where to go from here. It’s all sort of...uncharted territory for me. But it’s nothing personal.
: I’m just keeping you out of it since you have more than enough on your plate already.
: So you’re really not gonna tell me?...
: I’m really not gonna tell you.
: Trust me. You’ll be way happier this way.
: But what about you?
: Uta, come on.
: There’s barely a “me” left at this point.
: What about me?
: Are you really going to be happy about this if you just bottle everything up again?
: You know...
: For the first time ever, I think I might.
: Attention, roommates!
: The most attractive women in Kumon-mi have returned.
: And we’ve come bearing gifts!
: Is that a friggin’ crab?
: This little guy wandered up to us while we were diggin’ in the sand earlier and now Tsuneyo’s gonna kill him.
: I have provided for this family. I am a strong, independent woman who don’t need no man.
: You feelin’ any better over there, Io? Still want me leavin’ you alone?
: Are you really going to kill that thing in our room?
: You need to stop dodging the question when people ask you how you’re feeling.
: Don’t worry about me. I just think that thing’s cute and I don’t want to watch it die.
: I understand now. She is unwell because she never learned how to close her eyes.
: How horrible she must feel for my attractiveness to be entirely inescapable.
: Nah, I think she’s just got that depression thingy Makoto has.
: Hah...
: See? Ya can tell by the sigh.
: You two might wanna close the door before Io goes on a crazy rant about depression again.
: Understood. But please advise as to whether or not the two of you will be partaking in our crustaceous bounty.
: Yeah. It’s only a matter of time ‘til this thing latches onto me. I just hope it’ll be easier to get off than the friggin’ blobfish.
: I’m not hungry. Thanks, though.
: We’ll both eat. Thanks for cooking, Tsunecchi.
: Your wish is my command.
: Wish? You some kinda genie n’AAAAAAH FRICK! HE’S GOT MY FINGER! I’M GONNA HAVE TO USE MY OTHER HAND FOR...STUFF NOW!
: Uta, what the hell? I just said I wasn’t hungry.
: Yes, but it is my duty as your best friend to feed you when you’re not feeling like yourself.
: Is it? Have I been neglecting my duties for the entire duration of our friendship?
: I love you. Okay?
: Yeah, I love you too. But why do you need to be three inches from my face to tell me that?
: Because I need you to understand it.
: I get that you don’t want to talk about whatever it is that happened. And yeah, that makes me really sad, but I’ll accept it so long as you promise to come to me if it ever gets unbearable, okay?
: Okay.
: You really promise?
: I really promise.
: Really really?
: Really really.
: Okay...
: Okay.
: Now it’s your turn!
: My turn to what?
: Attempt to withstand my verbal assault as I become a hypocrite once more and say some stuff about how you should talk to me when you have problems.
: I have problems?
: Mhm.
: Current ones?
: Mhm.
: Unless you’ve already managed to forget that our teacher had some very inappropriate pictures of you on his phone.
: Oh...that.
: So you really did forget then? Wish I could do that. Life would be like five hundred times easier.
: I haven’t forgotten, but...
: Maybe, like...
: Maybe that’s...not as big of an issue as...it sounds?....
: Not an issue, Uta? Really?
: Have you forgotten why you’re here too? Why you had to leave your hometown behind? Come up with a brand new style and persona? Have you forgotten all of that?
: Of course not...
: Then how can you look me in the eyes like that and tell me it’s not a problem?
: Uta-
: I think I’m in love with him.
: You’re...
: You’re what?
: And so...I don’t mind...so long as it’s him.
: You mean like...you’re in love with him like you were in love with Spongebob Squarepants?
: Wha- of course not...
: Or that boy who used to work at the convenience store? Or Tony the Tiger? Or that boy who used to work at the library? Or whatever the Cheetos cat’s name is?
: Chester. But Io, this is different from all of those things...
: And the reason I’m telling you is because you specifically told me to not let you be the barrier between us. And you won’t be. I just...
: I really don’t know if I can hold back any longer.
: Any longer?! How long has this been going on for?!
: Too long...and I’m sorry. I just didn’t want to hurt you and-
: Uta, you fucking moron! I literally told you I wanted this to happen so the three of us could be together!
: You did, yeah! But that was a really fucking weird thing to suggest and I refused to believe you were actually serious!
: Of course I was serious, you idiot. God, this changes everything! Why didn’t you tell me sooner?
: Because I don’t want to be part of a throuple, Io!
: I want to be with him as a traditional couple. Two people. That’s it.
: I don’t want anyone else holding his hand. I don’t want anyone else cuddling with him. I don’t want anyone else kissing him. I want him and all of him and I would give him all of me in return.
: But, Io...I will throw away even the idea of that right now if you ask me to. Because you are even more important to me than he is.
: What the fuck do you expect me to say to that, Uta?...
: Do you really think I’m going to look you in the eyes and tell you not to follow your heart when I want you to find happiness even more than I want that for myself? Do you really think I’d do that?
: That’s not-
: Go after him, Uta.
: Get married. Buy a house. Adopt Sir Meowington the 5th. Make babies. Do all of that shit and leave me behind because I clearly am a barrier between you two.
: But promise me that you’re 10000%% sure. Because you’ve said it yourself that you’re impulsive and-
: I’m 10000000%% sure...but I am not leaving you behind. Ever.
: I’m just going to get in the way.
: Then I’ll make room so you can fit.
: So the throuple is back on?
: Ugh...I don’t know. This is all so confusing.
: There are like seven billion people in the world and we both had to fall for the same one. It’s not fair.
: Yeah, but at least you can give him what he wants.
: You don’t know for sure that’s what he wants, Io.
: God, I wish you were right...but you’re not.
: I do know that’s what he wants...now more than ever. Which also means that I know it just...wouldn’t work.
: So go. Don’t even think about me. I’ll just...watch the game from the dugout or something.
: Io-
: You have just as good of a chance as me...
: You’re asking me to compete with literal perfection.
: I’m asking you to compete with the hollowed out shell of a girl whose head keeps falling off of her shoulders every single time she hops out of bed.
: I’m a mess, Io. It’s Uta-chan who’s perfect.
: They’re both you, Uta. They’ve always been you. And none of those flaws are actually flaws to me.
: So go. Don’t even think about me. I’ll just...watch the game from the dugout or something.
: Io-
: Oi! Food’s almost done! You two gonna eat out here with us or do ya wanna come grab some yourselves?
: Pause?
: Pause. You were right. I’m hungry now.
: Do you still love me?
: Do you still love me?
: I’ll always love you.
: I’ll always love you too.
: Wanna just leave Sensei behind and go get married ourselves?
: Can we eat first? I haven’t had anything since last night.
: And this is exactly why best friends feed one another...
And so the four girls partake in the consumption of the body of Christ.
I mean crab.
The four girls partake in the consumption of the body of crab.
But you and me go somewhere more fun.
